# What Is Context?

#### Course: React Beyond Basics

## What Is Context?

Context is React's built-in solution for sharing data across the component tree without manually passing it through every layer.

Think of it like a broadcast system. Instead of handing a walkie-talkie along a chain of people, you set up a radio tower.

Any component in the tree can tune in and receive the signal, no matter how deep it lives.

Context has two parts:

- Provider: Wraps a section of the component tree and holds the value. Any component inside this wrapper can read the value.
- Consumer: Any component that calls useContext() to read the value. No props needed. No intermediate components involved.

![Provider and Consumers](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)
